title: Replacement for falsely completed task 14239: design(pm-stack): one identity across the stack — SSO propagation from the public entry into every layer, roles replace asserted authorship (#1253)
body: Replacement task enqueued by lane code-w (2026-11-09) after task 14239 was erroneously completed as already_done during a GitHub GraphQL rate-limit outage: the worker's fresh-state read returned empty and the completion was recorded without evidence. Fresh REST verification shows issue #1253 is OPEN. Work this task as the original triage task: revalidate against current GitHub state, then proceed per the runbook.
